addBible.checking: Reading and checking every book, chapter and verse. This can take a few seconds.
addBible.done_one: {{name}} is ready to read, with {{count}} book and {{verses}} verses.
addBible.done_other: {{name}} is ready to read, with {{count}} books and {{verses}} verses.
addBible.confirmBody: Next, Abiding Word checks every book, chapter and verse and shows you what it found. Nothing is added until you confirm.
addBible.ownBody: Choose a Bible in USFM format: a .zip download, or its .usfm files. Abiding Word keeps its own copy and never changes your file.
addBible.problems_one: {{count}} problem must be fixed before this Bible can be added
addBible.problems_other: {{count}} problems must be fixed before this Bible can be added
addBible.skipped_one: {{count}} file was left out because it is not one of the 66 books (for example an introduction or glossary).
addBible.skipped_other: {{count}} files were left out because they are not one of the 66 books (for example an introduction or glossary).

words.parts: With a lemma: {{lemmas}} · with lexical numbers: {{ids}} · with a grammar code: {{morph}} · different lemmas: {{distinct}}
words.schemeOshb: Grammar codes follow the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible scheme and are described in words.
words.schemeRaw: Grammar codes are kept as written; their scheme is not described in words.
words.leftOut_one: {{formatted}} annotated word could not be read and is left out.
words.leftOut_other: {{formatted}} annotated words could not be read and are left out.

not.strongOnly_one: {{formatted}} word carries lexical numbers only (no lemma or grammar code). It is not used for lemma search; the text is not affected.
not.strongOnly_other: {{formatted}} words carry lexical numbers only (no lemmas or grammar codes). They are not used for lemma search; the text is not affected.
not.unreliable_one: The word annotations could not be read reliably ({{left}} of {{formatted}} could not be read), so none are added. The text is not affected.
not.unreliable_other: The word annotations could not be read reliably ({{left}} of {{formatted}} could not be read), so none are added. The text is not affected.
not.unreadable_one: The word annotations could not be read, so none are added. The text is not affected.
not.unreadable_other: The word annotations could not be read, so none are added. The text is not affected.
not.tooLarge_one: There are more word annotations than any Bible has, so none are added. The text is not affected.
not.tooLarge_other: There are more word annotations than any Bible has, so none are added. The text is not affected.

bibles.empty: No Bible has been added yet.
bibles.confirmRemove: Remove {{name}}? Its text will be deleted from Abiding Word. Your studies, passage links and notes are kept.
bibles.confirmRemoveManaged: Remove {{name}}? Its text will be deleted from Abiding Word, together with Abiding Word’s copy of the file (your original file is not touched). Your studies, passage links and notes are kept.

empty.noMatchSources: Nothing here matches. Try another source or colour.

concordance.hint: Finds the words as this Bible writes them.
concordance.none: “{{query}}” does not occur in this Bible.
concordance.lemmaHint: Uses this Bible’s own word annotations: the dictionary form (lemma), lexical numbers and grammar codes its edition gives each word. Nothing is looked up elsewhere.
concordance.lemmaUnavailable: This Bible has no word annotations, so it cannot be searched by lemma. Word and phrase search work as before.
concordance.entriesHint: One dictionary form can stand for different words, told apart by their lexical numbers. Choose one.
concordance.noEntry: “{{text}}” is not a lemma or lexical number in this Bible’s annotations.
concordance.grammarDescribed: Described with the Open Scriptures Hebrew Bible morphology table; the code is shown as written. Tick codes to see only those words.
concordance.grammarRaw: Grammar codes as this Bible writes them. Abiding Word does not describe this scheme in words. Tick codes to see only those words.
concordance.noneWithGrammar: No occurrences with the chosen grammar.

language.hint: Abiding Word uses it to read abbreviations you type (such as “Jn 3:5”) the way this Bible does.

words.fromMarkup: From this Bible’s own word annotations. Nothing is looked up elsewhere.
words.entryCount_one: This entry occurs {{formatted}} time in this Bible.
words.entryCount_other: This entry occurs {{formatted}} times in this Bible.
words.openWordStudy: Open a Word Study to use this word in it.
words.more_one: {{formatted}} more annotated word is not listed. Select fewer words to see it.
words.more_other: {{formatted}} more annotated words are not listed. Select fewer words to see them.
